name: Lord of the Femboys
source:
You spent three years apprenticing under a washed-up wizard only to end up clearing pest infestations from village cellars. Then an eccentric hermit knocks on your door with a wooden box, declaring you the child of prophecy.

The realm of Femborn is losing its vigor to an ancient entity known as the Withering One, draining the strength, stamina, and bedroom drive of an entire province. Your only weapon is the One Ring of Endless Endurance — a peculiar magical artifact whose true, intimate power only awakens through genuine bonds, deep trust, and nights spent by the fire.

To save the land, you must track down three missing champions who wandered into the wilds. The catch? They're single, exceptionally pretty, and far more interested in teasing you than taking the impending apocalypse seriously.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5212310/Lord_of_the_Femboys/?curator_clanid=46081279]Steam[/url]]
